title: Affine pro-etale vanishing for pulled-back injective abelian etale sheaves
statement: Let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] with small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $\nu_Y:Y_{\mathrm{proet}}\to Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ be their comparison geometric morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For every injective abelian sheaf $J$ on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and every integer $q>0$, $$H^q(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\nu_Y^{-1}J)=0.$$ The inverse image is on abelian sheaves, and cohomology is the right derived global-sections functor in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. No torsion, finite coefficient ring, constructibility, Noetherian or dimension hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the affine ind-etale basis and its existing finite covering refinement theorem. Restrict a covering sieve along the full cover-dense inclusion AffineProEt.toProEt, extract a finite jointly surjective family, and reindex it by Fin n. These maps form a pro-etale covering: each is weakly etale, and a finite family of affine morphisms is quasi-compact as a covering. The nerve intersections stay in the basis: the affine-basis inclusion preserves pullbacks and, for affine Y, the identity terminal object, hence finite limits; its induced functor on the slice preserves finite products. Transport the structural proAffineEtale property across the product comparison isomorphism. These are the two private Lean helpers.

Write q=n+1. Apply the proved upstream terminal-object finite-cover version of the general-site Cech criterion, CategoryTheory.Sheaf.subsingleton_H_succ_of_exactAt_cechComplex in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Sites.CechCriterion. Take B(V) to be proAffineEtale(V.hom). Its terminal object is the identity of affine Y. Supply the preceding finite refinement and nerve closure, and supply the new auxiliary exactAt_cechComplex_comparisonUpperStar_of_injective for each finite cover. The criterion gives exactly Subsingleton of the original standard-Ext cohomology type. Enough injectives is supplied by the Grothendieck-abelian sheaf-category instance, and HasExt is explicitly the original HasExt.standard model. This realizes the general-site Cech-criterion step using an already proved upstream declaration instead of the separate Sheaf implementation.
